description.en: Original nominal8m representative bedrock teaching patch: a deep rounded plunge basin lies directly below a recessed lower rock step and projecting lip, joined to continuous banks and an upstream bed. The undercut and basin have actual geometry and spatial connection; no blue water sheet, enlarged isolated pothole, old ledge recolor, flow simulation or measured locality/event. Only bedrock exported; landscape scale retained.
